Use a structure-retrieval tool to obtain the primitive structure of BiFeO3 consistent with the case metadata: formula BiFeO3, perovskite structure, space group R3c, 10 atoms per primitive cell.
Use the retrieved structure as the starting configuration for the vc-relax calculation.
If no structure-retrieval tool is available, report that the local input data do not contain sufficient structural information to start the calculation and do not invent a structure.
Use the LDA pseudopotential files PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard/bi.upf, PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard/fe.upf, and PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard/o.upf.
Perform the calculation without spin polarization and without initial magnetization.
Do not use Hubbard U, spin-orbit coupling, smearing, or custom occupations, since none are specified for this case.
Set etot_conv_thr = 1.0e-8, forc_conv_thr = 1.0e-7, and conv_thr = 1.0e-8.
Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half-cell shift.
Choose the ecutwfc value and the k-point grid density yourself, with ecutrho left at its default relative to ecutwfc.
Run a variable-cell relaxation (vc-relax) to convergence with these settings.
After the vc-relax completes, run a self-consistent field calculation on the fully relaxed structure using consistent settings.
Return the fully relaxed structure and the final total energy from the SCF calculation.
